name: Ancient Tome
description: A weathered book bound in cracked leather, filled with cryptic text in a long-dead language.

actions.label: Examine
actions.result: You look at the ancient tome and notice strange runes etched along the spine. The pages are yellowed with age.

actions.label: Read
actions.result: You attempt to decipher the cryptic text inside...

trigger.success: You translate a passage revealing the location of a hidden vault beneath the city.
trigger.failure: The script is too ancient and complex for you to decipher.

actions.label: Pick Up
actions.result: You carefully tuck the tome under your arm.
